GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.93 (29 Oct 46) GB
(SCAPIN - 1298)
APO 500
29 October 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Application for Permission to Move Meteorological Stations at Ominato, Mineyama, Kakogawa and Saheki
1. Reference C.L.O. Memorandum No. 4371 (CL) dated 23 Sept 1946, subject same as above.
2. General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers approves the application by the Director, Central Meteorological Observatory for permission to move the meteorological observatories now located at Ominato, Mineyama, Kakogawa and Saheki to the more efficient and suitable locations specified in the memorandum CMO 104 (G-P) dated 18 Sept 1946 same subject as above.
3. Permission sought is hereby granted to move meteorological stations as follows:
Old Location Long Lat. Now Location Long. Lat.
Ominato 141.2 41.2 to Tanabe 141.1 41.2
Mineyama 135.4 35.6 to Maizuru 135.3 35.5
Kakogawa 134.8 34.7 to Himeji 134.4 34.5
Saheki 131.5 33.0 to Nobeoka 131.4 32.4
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
